desc: RDMA CM communication server test program
r: rdma_xserver - RDMA CM communication server test program
Uses the librdmacm to establish various forms of communication and exchange data.

<dl><dt data-o="">-p port</dt><dd>Changes the port number that the server listens on. By default the server listens on port 7471.</dd><dt data-o="">-c communication type</dt><dd>Specifies the type of communication established with the client program. 'r' results in using a reliable-connected QP (the default). 'x' uses extended reliable-connected XRC QPs.</dd></dl>

Basic usage is to start rdma_xserver, then connect to the server using the rdma_xclient program.

Because this test maps RDMA resources to userspace, users must ensure that they have available system resources and permissions. See the libibverbs README file for additional details.
